events.what: Inoue, Kawarabayashi, Matsuo, Miyashita, Mohar & Sonobe prove the apex case of three-edge-colouring cubic Petersen-minor-free graphs, completing (with the 2014/2016 doublecross case) the cubic restriction of the 4-flow conjecture
events.ai_basis: Copilot for verification software, ChatGPT Pro/Gemini for exposition and consistency review, ChatGPT Pro/Claude Code for independent reimplementation; 'not part of the mathematical justification of the theorem'

events.what: Pintér proves nowhere-zero 4-flows for bridgeless graphs excluding P/e as a minor (a subclass of Petersen-minor-free graphs)
events.ai_basis: ChatGPT and Claude used 'for literature research, editorial assistance, and help writing the accompanying code'

judgement.doubts: Both events are same-tier cases with ai_role none, so credited_humans listing authors of both is acceptable. The researcher's competing_reading suggesting 'claimed' reflects the F1 conflation; a case is partial regardless of verification. The apex proof is computer-assisted and unreviewed; the Pith Review caveat is automated and not a knock-down (F11).
